name: Vanilla RS-NeRF
definition: A framework that reconstructs a NeRF from rolling shutter (RS) images by explicitly modeling the camera's motion trajectory during exposure and jointly optimizing NeRF parameters and camera extrinsics for each image row.
summary: Vanilla RS-NeRF reconstructs NeRFs from rolling shutter images by modeling continuous camera motion per row, handling motion blur and distortions that standard NeRFs cannot.
